game.name: Clive Barker's Jericho (USA)(Beta)(2007-09-04)
game.desc: The game takes players into the near future as the seven members of the Jericho Squadron. This team, created by the US government and trained in the use of both conventional and paranormal weapons, is tasked with exploring Al-Khali, an ancient lost city that has risen from the rubble in a remote desert. The squadron's mission is to hunt down and destroy the evil lurking at the heart of the city before it destroys humanity.
game.genre: Action, Shooter / FPV, Shooter, Adventure / Survival Horror, Adventure
